g.text: Bands follow contrast colours: minimum–maximum across draws, NOT confidence intervals.

g.text: O/E uses the query-matched background. RA weights each shared model by inverse observed degree in the fixed 92-gene arm.

g.text: Historical pan-cancer fitness reference, reused during development. RA is uncalibrated affinity; zero is not a biological negative.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #49545e

g.text: Exploratory concordance only: no independent confirmation, calibrated accuracy or automatic-pruning claim.
